summary: This bill gives the full force of law to all rules, policies, regulatory rescissions, and cost-saving measures issued or directed by the Department of Government Efficiency and keeps them in effect until changed by DOGE or Congress.

scores.thoughts: The bill explicitly codifies all budgetary savings, efficiency measures, and related actions taken by DOGE, requiring them to be maintained notwithstanding other laws or appropriations. This directly entrenches spending reductions and government efficiency reforms into law, pushing strongly toward reduced government spending.
The bill contains no provisions related to tax policy, rates, or revenue collection.
No provisions address healthcare policy, coverage, or regulation.
No provisions address firearms, gun regulations, or Second Amendment issues.
No provisions address immigration policy, borders, or related enforcement.
No provisions address abortion access or reproductive policy.
No provisions specifically address military or defense spending.
No provisions address environmental regulations or climate policy.
No provisions address welfare programs, food assistance, or social safety net programs.
No provisions address education funding, schools, or related policy.
No provisions address drug enforcement, decriminalization, or related policy.
No provisions address criminal justice, sentencing, or policing.
No provisions address trade, tariffs, or globalization.
By codifying and locking in DOGE-identified budgetary savings and efficiency measures, the bill prioritizes deficit reduction and debt control through permanent spending restraint.
No provisions address LGBTQ+ legal protections or related civil rights.
No provisions specifically address foreign aid.
No provisions address voting access, election integrity, or related reforms.
No provisions address technology regulation, data privacy, or oversight of tech companies.
No provisions address labor rights, unions, or workplace regulations.
No provisions address religious exemptions or anti-discrimination laws.
